physicalEvidence.summary: The full June 2026 Knows study filters pi0.5 actions using attention-head target identification, fine-tuned YOLOE object masks, geometric tracking and a CBF-QP. Evaluation uses SafeLIBERO, including added moving obstacles; the hardware subsection describes GPU workstations and rendered environments, not a physical arm. The filter models only the end effector, and full-arm collisions, perception errors and downstream controller tracking remain limitations. The February 2026 geometric meta-RL paper is a two-dimensional numerical navigation task. The inspected 2023 spacecraft perception/control paper also uses simulation. No real learned robot execution is credited.

shortVisit.summary: The live prospective-students page explicitly says non-UCLA students interested in summer research internships should email by April 1 of the intended year, within its master/undergraduate section. Its introductory examples still mention2026, but the outside-student rule is recurring rather than year-specific. For summer2027 the published annual rule therefore points to April 1, 2027; this is an inquiry deadline, not a guaranteed offer, funded position or formal program admission.

name: Alexander (Sasha) Davydov
title: Assistant Professor (July 1, 2025–)
department: Mechanical Engineering; Control and Reliable Autonomy Lab
fitReason: New Assistant Professor with personally attributable actual full-scale vehicle-learning experiments at Toyota Research Institute. Current Rice PhD supervision is verified, while Rice vehicle access and external-master intake remain unknown.

physicalEvidence.status: Verified prior-TRI actual learned vehicle control, first preprint2024; physical20; Rice hardware unknown
physicalEvidence.summary: The original October 2024 full preprint, later published in2025, verifies actual Toyota Supra control using neural-feature/Bayesian-last-layer learned dynamics within100Hz MPC. Information-rich4.5-second driving trajectories adapt the model before dynamic figure-eight drifting. Comparisons show online adaptation alone can produce large transients or spin-outs; prior information gathering improves reliability. The paper explicitly states Davydov performed this work at Toyota Research Institute, before Rice. This proves learned vehicle execution but does not establish a current Rice test vehicle or a new2025 experiment. July 2026 constrained-flow work uses numerical/image tasks, not new physical robotics.
